Name: Content Patcher - Toy Piano Furniture
Author: Mushroomyx
Description:
This Content Pack adds a small Toy Piano you can sit at. While it is usable as a standalone content Pack, this Pack is intended as a companion to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551]Playable Piano Mod[/url] in order to showcase, how to add musical playing capabilities to any piece furniture you can sit on.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Playing the Piano[/size]
Sit down at the Piano and press a Key. This will open up a Menu where you can choose between Freeplay and Midi Playback Mode.

For further Information please refer to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551]Playable Piano [/url] Mod Page.
